sentences.zh: 毅攻魯山城，道規攻偃月壘，無忌遏中流，自辰至午，二城俱潰，生禽山圖、仙客，該走石城。。

translations.literal: Yi attacked Lucheng Mountain, Daogui attacked Crescent Fortress, and Wuji blocked the midstream. From the hour chen to the hour wu, both fortresses were breached; Shantu and Xianke were taken alive, and Gai fled to Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yi assaulted Lucheng Mountain while Daogui struck Crescent Fortress and He Wuji held the mid-river. From chen to wu both strongholds fell. Meng Shantu and Huan Xianke were captured alive; Feng Gai fled to Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，魏大赦，改元天賜。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Wei proclaimed a great amnesty and changed the era name to Tianci.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Northern Wei proclaimed a general amnesty and adopted the era name Tianci.

sentences.zh: 築西宮。

translations.literal: They built the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Work began on the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月，魏主珪如西宮，命宗室置宗師，八國置大師、小師，州郡亦各置師，以辨宗黨，舉才行，如魏、晉中正之職。。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the Wei ruler Gui went to the Western Palace and ordered the imperial clan to establish clan mentors; the eight states to establish great and lesser mentors; and the provinces and commanderies each to establish mentors as well, to distinguish clans and kindreds and recommend talent and conduct, like the zhongzheng offices of Wei and Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Tuoba Gui moved into the Western Palace and ordered clan mentors for the imperial kindred, great and lesser mentors for the eight domains, and mentors in every province and commandery to sort lineages and recommend men of talent, in the manner of the Wei and Jin zhongzheng system.

sentences.zh: 燕王熙與苻後游畋，北登白鹿山，東逾青嶺，南臨滄海而還，士卒為虎狼所殺及凍死者五千餘人。。

translations.literal: The King of Yan Xi went hunting and sporting with Lady Fu. They ascended White Deer Mountain in the north, crossed Green Ridge in the east, faced the blue sea in the south, and returned. Soldiers killed by tigers and wolves and those who froze to death numbered more than five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: King Xi of Yan went hunting with Lady Fu. They climbed White Deer Mountain in the north, crossed Green Ridge to the east, and looked out on the sea in the south before turning home. Tigers, wolves, and the cold killed more than five thousand of the soldiers who followed them.

sentences.zh: 十二月，劉毅等進克巴陵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Liu Yi and the others advanced and took Baling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Liu Yi and his colleagues captured Baling.

sentences.zh: 毅號令嚴整，所過百姓安悅。

translations.literal: Yi's orders were strict and well ordered; wherever they passed, the common people were secure and pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yi's discipline was ironclad, and the people along his line of march were calm and grateful.

sentences.zh: 劉裕復以毅為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Yu again made Yi Inspector of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu restored Liu Yi to the Yanzhou inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 桓振以桓放之為益州刺史，屯西陵；

translations.literal: Huan Zhen made Huan Fangzhi Inspector of Yizhou, stationed at Xiling;
translations.idiomatic: Huan Zhen appointed Huan Fangzhi Inspector of Yizhou and posted him at Xiling;

sentences.zh: 文處茂擊破之，放之走還江陵。。

translations.literal: Wen Chumao attacked and defeated him; Fangzhi fled back to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: but Wen Chumao defeated him and drove him back to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 高句麗侵燕。。

translations.literal: Goguryeo invaded Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo invaded Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，魏主珪如豺山宮。。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Wei ruler Gui went to Chanshan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Wei ruler Tuoba Gui went to Chanshan Palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，晉民避亂，襁負之淮北者道路相屬。。

translations.literal: This year, Jin common people fleeing turmoil, carrying infants on their backs north of the Huai—the roads were unbroken with them.
translations.idiomatic: That year Jin subjects fleeing the chaos poured north of the Huai, infants on their backs, until the roads were one unbroken stream of refugees.
